[shr-00001] When the target object is not immediately visible, systematically search all relevant locations before concluding it is not present.

[shr-00004] When the target object is not found on the surface of an object, consider searching inside it (e.g., opening containers or receptacles) if such actions are available.
[shr-00007] When multiple instances of the target object are present, prioritize the one that is most accessible or directly visible unless the task specifies a particular instance. If no distinction is provided, select the first encountered instance.
